## Deviations (recorded, not smoothed)

1. **`/network/` stands in for "Graph explorer".** SIG-UI-051's
   canonical item names the graph explorer; `/explore/` is a later
   row's route. The item renders against `network/` today and is
   declared for `explore/` — a release serving it lights the entry
   without a code change.
2. **`release-routes` computes from `import.meta.glob`, not a
   filesystem walk.** An `import.meta.url`-anchored `readdirSync`
   resolves inside `dist/.prerender/` at build (ENOENT); the glob keys
   exist identically in dev, vitest and the prerender bundle.
3. **The mobile search entry is a compact link, not the field.** K14
   §5.3's ≤ 56 px bar names "a search icon linking to `/search/`" —
   the GET field stays on the desktop bar; at 320 px the link stands
   in so the row never wraps into the H1's budget.
4. **The mobile breadcrumb trail is one line.** A long record title
   wrapped into the H1's 120 px budget; ancestors never truncate, the
   current crumb — the title the H1 repeats directly below — takes the
   ellipsis.
5. **The fake-form assertion scoped to `main`.** The header's GET
   search is a `<form>` on every page; the dispute page's "no
   submission path" test now counts `main form` — the intent (no fake
   intake) is unchanged.
6. **The SIG-UI-044 module stays one action away on record pages
   too.** SIG-UI-145's final text: "MUST be one action away and MUST
   be page-specific on record pages" — the disclosure posture binds
   everywhere; page-specificity is the page-scoped provenance row a
   record passes (the fixture dossier has none → honestly labelled
   site-wide).
7. **Canonical item lists only.** The menus carry exactly the
   §56.11-enumerated membership (Data dictionary, Data freshness,
   Coverage, Style guide were dropped — the routes remain reachable;
   the section's `match` still marks them current).

## Fix arc (recorded)

1. **Route-manifest fs walk → `import.meta.glob`** — the
   `import.meta.url`-anchored `readdirSync(PAGES_DIR)` resolved inside
   `dist/.prerender/` during prerender (ENOENT at `/403`); the glob
   keys exist in every runtime (Deviation 2).
2. **Path-containment growth in `release-routes.ts`** — three
   `"/"`-leading literals (`"/index"`, `"/"`) tripped
   `check-root-absolute-paths`; rewritten with `basename()`/`posix.sep`
   — no literal slashes, containment holds.
3. **Baseline shrink recorded** — the header's 18 literals dropped
   out of BaseLayout (157 → 141); `check-root-absolute-paths
   --write-baseline` recorded per the shrink-only rule.
4. **Mobile bar wrapped to two rows** — wordmark + field + button +
   menu exceeded 320 px; K14 §5.3's compact search link + tightened
   gaps restored one row (the H1's 120 px budget held after).
5. **Breadcrumb wrap pushed the dossier H1 to 147 px** — one-line
   trail with the current crumb ellipsised (the H1 repeats the title);
   measured ≈ 100 px.
6. **`form` count regression** — the dispute page's "no submission
   path" assertion caught the header's GET search; scoped to
   `main form` (Deviation 5).
7. **`recordPage` open-details posture reverted** — an earlier draft
   opened the footer disclosure on record pages; SIG-UI-145's final
   text binds one-action-away on every page — reverted before commit
   (Deviation 6).
8. **K13 §2.1 fidelity fixes** — `feeds/` → `watch/feeds/`; declared
   Downloads & API / Releases & changes / Contact rows; the About
   menu re-ordered to the canonical list (Methodology before
   "How sure is SIG?").
9. **WM-01 pin restore** — the copy-batch row binds
   `aria-label="SIG Surveillance Infrastructure Graph — home"` to
   `BaseLayout.astro` verbatim; the refactor carried it into
   `SiteHeader.astro`. Repaired: the literal is authored in
   BaseLayout's frontmatter and rendered via the `wordmarkLabel`
   prop — one source of truth, the pin keeps its file binding.
10. **`/network/` island-mount CLS** — the head-bound `web` job's
    Lighthouse leg measured `cumulative-layout-shift` 0.0687 on all
    three runs against the ≤ 0.05 ceiling (the only hard failure;
    `/map/` TBT 788.5 and `/search/` LCP/script-size were recorded
    warnings, not assertions). The graph island mounts ~95 rem tall
    at the 412 px budget viewport inside a ~150 px section and pushes
    `section[data-testid="network-view"]` ~1,500 px down — the same
    defect the map placeholder already fixed; the racy mount-vs-trace
    timing explains why the pre-change runs read 0. Repaired with the
    established `sig-island__placeholder` pattern: a sibling reserves
    the mounted height (`min-height` stepped 95/85/73 rem in
    `islands.css` from fixtures-build measurements at the grid
    breakpoints) and `.sig-graph-island:has([data-testid="network-island"])`
    hides it the moment the island root exists — all three local
    `/network/` runs then measured CLS 0 and TBT 0, `npm run
    check:perf` green. The honest no-JS note rides the box.
11. **CHANGELOG gate** — the `docs` job's SIG-REL-014 gate flagged
    `BaseLayout.astro` + `dossier/[...path].astro` (public-behaviour
    paths) with no `## [Unreleased]` entry; added the Changed entry
    naming P36.18 / row 358 / SIG-UI-051+145+150 — local gate re-run
    green.
12. **National budget-leg byte bounds** — the `web` job's national
    wire-measure on the records head `d291905a` failed twice: `/network/`
    `totalInitialMaxBytes` 1,900,589 B past the recorded 1,900,000 B
    regression bound (+589; the chrome's ≈ 4.5 KB gz per-page transfer —
    header/band/footer markup + epistemic chrome styles — carried the
    real-scale page over), and `/search/` `totalInitialMaxBytes` 192,259 B
    past the ratified 184,320 B ceiling (no gap row existed; the recorded
    React-runtime script overage — 72,853 vs 61,440 B gz — alone accounts
    for the excess). Repaired per the `measured_gaps` mechanism, never a
    smoothed ceiling: the `/network/` row re-recorded (measure 1,900,589,
    bound 1,920,000; the `documentMaxBytes` measure re-recorded at
    1,779,527, bound 1,800,000 standing) under D-P35.51-3, and a new
    national-scoped `/search/` `totalInitialMaxBytes` row recorded under
    D-P35.51-2 (the K0 runtime-migration row owns the root cause and the
    stale-row gate removes it when Preact lands). Ratified ceilings
    unchanged — deferrals +0/−0 stands. `gen-lhci` in sync (the matrix

    47/47 green, fixtures budgets 47/47 green.
13. **Row-354 freeze-window defect, chained** — `python` on `26e54b77`
    (run 40624323150, started 03:01Z) failed
    `test_check_dry_run_is_green_without_adc[rate-limit-enforcement.sh]`:
